score.interpretation: Strong checkpoint-bound model and payload bridge with independently reproduced all-weight and ten-sample numeric evidence. One P1 prevents the CUDA-derived integer/RNE counts from being treated as backend-independent frozen architectural evidence until arithmetic flags or an explicit integer reference are added.

multicast_hardware_finding.conclusion: The repeated-value statistic is diagnostic only. Materializing one 96-bit destination mask plus one value per command expands storage by 8.392x and is rejected as an SRAM/fetch format or a speedup claim. Any later architecture must generate grouping implicitly or use a different locality/codebook mechanism and prove bank-feasible cycles.

tests_and_attacks.repin_observation: A semantically forged MAE was accepted after generating an entirely new pin with a new SHA, as expected from a parameterized manifest validator. Therefore consumers must compare the pin to the authoritative SHA 0a5de887...186f1b before invoking the validator; validator PASS alone is not release identity.

findings.title: CUDA arithmetic backend flags are not frozen in the producer identity
findings.evidence: With TF32 enabled, all 92,160,000 support-times-INT8 CUDA Conv2d outputs were exact float integers and reproduced the reported 1348 RNE changes. With TF32 disabled, 58,952,741 outputs had fractional floating tails up to 0.03662109375, although every value rounded to the same integer and 160 exact CPU dot products matched.
findings.impact: The mathematical integer result is sound, but deterministic_algorithms=true does not by itself freeze the arithmetic path. The exact-integrality assertion and exact RNE population are not portable producer evidence until the TF32/cuDNN policy is explicit or the audit uses an explicit integer reference.
findings.required_repair: In M41 r2, record torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32, torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32, CUDA and cuDNN versions and algorithm identity; preferably recover/verify integer accumulators explicitly by rounding plus an integer oracle before computing RNE statistics. Re-pin the release.

findings.title: Release validation depends on an externally trusted canonical pin SHA
findings.evidence: The validator accepts --pin and correctly validates the supplied manifest, but does not hard-code the canonical pin SHA. A semantically altered MAE plus a newly computed alternate pin passed structural validation.
findings.impact: This is safe only when the caller first verifies the authoritative pin SHA. A bare validator PASS is not sufficient provenance.
findings.required_repair: Document and automate a wrapper that checks the canonical pin SHA before calling the parameterized validator, or make canonical mode enforce its own expected pin digest.

findings.title: UQ0.31 scales and late-scale elimination remain candidates rather than a runtime fixed-point contract
findings.evidence: The scale payloads are exact and the RNE diagnostic is strong, but runtime scale application, requantization, dynamic BatchNorm and an RTL rounding stage are explicitly not admitted.
findings.impact: The bridge cannot yet establish end-to-end numerical equivalence or a cycle reduction from scale elimination.
findings.required_repair: Freeze the post-accumulator scale/BatchNorm/requantization order and rounding/saturation contract, then miter it against the model before architectural cycle claims.

findings.title: The ten-sample raw-convolution cohort is not an accuracy or distribution result
findings.evidence: The four raw-convolution gates are strong, with NRMSE 0.202%-0.411% and cosine at least 0.99999156, but valid825, dynamic BatchNorm and the rest of the network are absent by contract.
findings.impact: No accuracy-preservation or cross-sequence claim follows from this milestone.
findings.required_repair: Run the frozen INT8/full fixed-point path through valid825 and the planned cross-sequence/event-density cohorts after the runtime numeric contract is closed.

admitted: checkpoint-bound four-layer signed INT8 weight payload and layout
per-output float32 and UQ0.31 scale payload equivalence
all-weight quantization error, saturation and reserved-code audit
checkpoint-specific 19-bit and dense 21-bit accumulator lower bounds
rounding-aware late-scale diagnostic after the P1 reproducibility qualification
diagnostic weight-reuse and explicit value-mask statistics
not_admitted: dynamic no-running BatchNorm or end-to-end fixed-point equivalence
explicit value-mask compression, accumulator-cycle reduction or bank-feasible issue rate
real M40/M42 address and cycle schedule
RTL, VCS, Synopsys synthesis, STA, Formality, PPA, power or energy

next_gate: Issue an M41 r2 arithmetic-identity hardening release before citing the exact 1348 RNE population.
Use the signed INT8 payload as M42 scheduling input, but keep weight load/eviction, SRAM banks, accumulator ownership and cycles blocked until explicitly modeled.

Do not implement explicit per-command 96-bit destination masks; investigate implicit broadcast grouping, offline reordered output-channel tiles or small codebook/run formats and account for metadata bytes and bank conflicts.
Close post-accumulator BatchNorm/requantization and run valid825 before any accuracy or system headline.
